verdict.rationale: The privacy page says chat data is stored locally on the client by default, with cloud sync as an option. The desktop app is marketed as running locally and privacy-first, and self-hosting docs cover Ollama integration, so a user can keep conversations away from third-party model providers. These are indirect protections, not an explicit training opt-out. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training policy or statement, a user-facing opt-out control for cloud sync or hosted models, documentation of how data reaching upstream providers is handled, and independent corroboration.
